operators.name: Check Out Wisconsin State Parks At Your Library

prep.label: Where to start
prep.text: Use the DNR’s county-by-county list to find a participating library. Ask your branch about eligibility and the day you can collect a pass.

prep.label: Where it applies
prep.text: The state lists a daily vehicle pass for eligible state parks, forests and recreation areas. Check separate trail-pass requirements for your activity.

operators.name: York County Library South Carolina State Park Passport

prep.label: Check the catalogue
prep.text: Find State Park Passports in the online catalogue. Passes are first come, first served at the branches.

prep.label: How to return it
prep.text: Return both pass pieces to the branch that lent them. County-operated parks have a separate entry system.

operators.name: Mesa County Libraries Colorado State Parks Pass

prep.label: Choose your library
prep.text: Most Mesa County branches carry the state park pass, with Gateway and De Beque excluded. Check the current catalogue.

prep.label: Check the destination
prep.text: Mesa County lists a separate pass for Colorado National Monument. Use the state park pass for the applicable Colorado State Parks route.

prep.label: Where to get it
prep.text: Ask a local California public library about checkout and availability. The state parks FAQ links to excluded sites.

prep.label: Vehicle limit
prep.text: Use one passenger vehicle with a seating capacity of nine or fewer, or one highway-licensed motorcycle.

operators.name: Anne Arundel County Public Library Maryland State Park Pass

prep.label: Who can ride
prep.text: The library lists one vehicle with up to ten people.

prep.label: Check park dates
prep.text: The library identifies parks with day-use reservations on applicable weekends and holidays from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. Verify the current park rules.

operators.name: Northern Onondaga Public Library Empire Parks Pass

prep.label: Before you go
prep.text: Check the catalogue for a pass. The library provides one pass per location and one per borrowing card.

prep.label: Bring the pass
prep.text: Show the pass at the entrance. Return it in person at the library.

operators.name: Toronto Public Library Ontario Parks Pass

prep.label: How to borrow
prep.text: Use your Toronto Public Library card to place a hold. Return the pass by the due date to avoid a replacement fee.

prep.label: How to plan your visit
prep.text: Check the Ontario Parks day-use page for dates, participating parks and the separate advance permit route.

rules.text: Participating libraries provide a daily vehicle admission pass for the Wisconsin State Park System sites that charge for vehicle entry.
The published offer is a one-day vehicle pass. Ask your branch when to collect it for your planned visit.
This library program offers daily vehicle admission. Wisconsin handles camping reservations separately.
The State Park Passport covers state park entry for occupants of the vehicle.
York County Library explicitly excludes holds. Check the catalogue for available passes.
The loan is one week. The library allows one renewal.
The state parks pass covers one vehicle. Display the pass from the backpack or pouch as directed.
Mesa County takes holds on passes and holds a ready item for two business days.
The library’s standard pass checkout is seven days. Verify the due date at pickup.
The pass covers vehicle day use at participating California state park units. It excludes separate per-person or tour charges.
The official FAQ excludes camping charges.
The pass is usable when space is available. It does not reserve a parking space or override capacity.
The library lists free day-use entry to Maryland State Parks for one vehicle with up to ten people.
Checkout is seven days. The library does not allow renewals on this pass.
The published benefit is day-use access.
A borrowed pass does not remove the separate day-use reservation requirement at the named parks on applicable dates.
The Empire Pass covers the personal vehicle fee at most qualifying New York state-operated park and day-use sites.
The library lends available passes in arrival order and does not allow holds.
The loan is three days and cannot be renewed.
Camping fees and other separately charged activities are outside this pass’s listed coverage.
The library says entry is subject to special event rules and park capacity.
The pass provides day-use access to qualifying provincial parks for the occupants of one vehicle.
Eligible Toronto cardholders can place a hold in the library catalogue.
The checkout period is up to one week.
This day-use pass excludes overnight stays and equipment rental.
Capacity still applies. Use Ontario Parks’ separate advance daily vehicle permit process wherever it applies.
